TEST_ONLY: Exact historical source bodies for one already-failed credential-free owner validation; no authority

files..github/workflows/install-baden-native-c:
name: Install reviewed immutable Baden native catalog
run-name: Same-head owner catalog DATA only - no registration or import
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      expected_sha:
        description: Exact reviewed deployed main writer SHA
        type: string
        required: true
      derived_run:
        description: Actual successful derived Baden composition run
        type: string
        required: true
      main_ci_run_id:
        description: Actual successful first-attempt push CI run at this writer
        type: string
        required: true
      reviewed_asset_id:
        description: Root-uploaded immutable JSON asset in private draft baden-native-staging-v1
        type: string
        required: true
      reviewed_manifest_sha256:
        description: Independently reviewed exact canonical native manifest SHA256
        type: string
        required: true
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: baden-native-catalog-owner-install
  cancel-in-progress: false
env:
  EXPECTED_SHA: ${{ inputs.expected_sha }}
  DERIVED_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.derived_run }}
  MAIN_CI_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.main_ci_run_id }}
  REVIEWED_ASSET_ID: ${{ inputs.reviewed_asset_id }}
  REVIEWED_MANIFEST_SHA256: ${{ inputs.reviewed_manifest_sha256 }}
  FROZEN_DE77_DIRECTORY: frozen-de77
  FROZEN_V6_DIRECTORY: frozen-v6
  MIGRACIJE_PREMOR: ${{ vars.MIGRACIJE_PREMOR }}
  NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=6144
jobs:
  validate:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.run_attempt == 1 && inputs.expected_sha == github.sha && github.actor == 'nejcar20' && github.actor_id == '25134229' && github.triggering_actor == 'nejcar20'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact reviewed writer
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout frozen DE77
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: de77b661cbc11d95256a500e57c2fdea861a0647
          path: frozen-de77
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout frozen failed V6
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 4e1e7caac02aa6e12c789c7cea7aac699d3c2566
          path: frozen-v6
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Node22
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Authenticate source, root review, writer and deployed main
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v psql >/dev/null || { echo "::error::Missing PostgreSQL client; HOLD."; exit 1; }
          node scripts/install-baden-native-catalog.mjs validate
      - name: Preserve validation evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: baden-catalog-validation-${{ github.run_id }}-1
          path: baden-native-catalog-install/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30
  install:
    needs: validate
    if: needs.validate.result == 'success' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.run_attempt == 1 && inputs.expected_sha == github.sha && github.actor == 'nejcar20' && github.actor_id == '25134229' && github.triggering_actor == 'nejcar20'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact reviewed writer
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout frozen DE77
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: de77b661cbc11d95256a500e57c2fdea861a0647
          path: frozen-de77
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout frozen failed V6
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: 4e1e7caac02aa6e12c789c7cea7aac699d3c2566
          path: frozen-v6
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Node22
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: npm
      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Validate again before owner connection
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          command -v psql >/dev/null || { echo "::error::Missing PostgreSQL client; HOLD."; exit 1; }
          node scripts/install-baden-native-catalog.mjs validate
      - name: Owner connection prerequisite
        id: owner
        env:
          SUPABASE_DB_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_DB_URL }}
        run: |
          if [ "$MIGRACIJE_PREMOR" = "1" ] || [ -z "$SUPABASE_DB_URL" ]; then
            echo "::error::Owner connection missing or migrations paused; HOLD."
            exit 1
          fi
          case "$SUPABASE_DB_URL" in *@127.0.0.1*) echo "tunnel=yes" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT";; esac
      # Same GHA-only loopback arrangement as CI, never a local credential path.
      - name: Tunnel to owner database
        if: steps.owner.outputs.tunnel == 'yes'
        env:
          KLJUC: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_SSH_KEY }}
          ZNANI: ${{ vars.DEPLOY_KNOWN_HOSTS }}
        run: |
          install -m 700 -d ~/.ssh
          printf '%s\n' "$KLJUC" > ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 && chmod 600 ~/.ssh/id_ed25519
          printf '%s\n' "$ZNANI" > ~/.ssh/known_hosts
          ssh -fN -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes -L 5432:127.0.0.1:5432 deploy@2.31.6.53
      - name: Install reviewed immutable catalog once
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          SUPABASE_DB_URL: ${{ secrets.SUPABASE_DB_URL }}
        run: node scripts/install-baden-native-catalog.mjs install
      - name: Preserve owner installation evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: baden-catalog-owner-install-${{ github.run_id }}-1
          path: baden-native-catalog-install/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30
